title: HDL Dysfunction During the Acute Stage of Stroke
brief_summary: The study investigates the effect of plasma myeloperoxidase (MPO) concentrations on HDL dysfunction during the acute stage of ischemic and haemorrhagic strokes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients with less than 12 hours stroke clinical signs:

* hemiparesis or hemiplegia
* unilateral sensitivity disorder
* language impairment
* balance disorder
* dizziness, bilateral or monocular vision totally or partially lost

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* head trauma since the last 3 months
* stroke since the last 3 months
* myocardial infarction since the last 3 months
* patient disagrees to be enrolled in the study
study_population: Adult patients with clinical picture of early stage of stroke with the first signed lasting for less than 12 hours
